speaker: rich
transcript: That picture was twenty years ago. Dad looks like he knew exactly where he belonged. I keep looking at his face in it, then thinking about the face I saw at that window. He didn’t wander past the house. He came right to the glass and stopped. For a second, I swear he knew me. Now I’ve got four antigen cartridges sitting on that cart. Four chances. I don’t know how long he’s been sick, or whether early stage is already behind him, but I can’t decide he’s gone. Not after he found his way home.
summary: Rich compares the old photograph with Dad's purposeful return to the window and refuses to give up on treating him.
defaultEmotion: reflective, frightened, hopeful, and emotionally guarded
